sources.entry: Carol - A minimal and beautiful lyrics app for macOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/AnaghSharma/Carol) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Carol - A minimal and beautiful lyrics app that stays in the menu bar of macOS.

summary.one_liner: Carol is a minimal macOS menu bar app, built with SwiftUI, that automatically shows lyrics for the song currently playing in Apple Music or Spotify.
summary.what_it_does: Carol detects the song currently playing and displays its lyrics. It lives in the macOS menu bar for one-click access. It supports both Apple Music and Spotify. The interface is minimal and can show album artwork, and it adapts to the system light or dark theme. The README describes the app as light in size. Requirements are macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later, and the user must grant permissions on first launch.
use_cases: view song lyrics from the menu bar
show lyrics for Apple Music tracks
learn SwiftUI by studying a macOS app
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the project's releases page (linked in the README).
Copy Carol to your Applications folder.
Launch Carol from the Applications folder; it appears in the menu bar.
Grant the requested permissions on first launch.
notable: Automatically identifies the currently playing song and fetches its lyrics
Works with both Apple Music and Spotify
Lives in the menu bar with one-touch access
Adapts to macOS light and dark themes and can show album artwork
caveats: README states the lyrics are copyrighted and the project is intended for learning purposes only; it must not be sold or re-sold
Needs system permissions granted on first launch
